title: Reaper Prime
extract:
The Reaper Prime is a standalone prime melee Scythe boasting high critical chance, status chance, and attack speed. It was released alongside  Frost Prime and  Latron Prime.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Reaping Spiral and  Shadow Harvest (Conclave only) stance.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Highest critical chance of all scythes.
Tied with the  Hate for the highest critical multiplier of all scythes.
Tied with  Anku,  Ether Reaper, and  Tenet Grigori for the fastest attack speed of all scythes.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On March 17, 2015, it was announced that the Reaper Prime, alongside  Frost Prime and  Latron Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on March 24, 2015. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.
This weapon was available for a limited time from December 8, 2015 through January 5, 2016, either as part of the purchase-able Frost Prime Vault package or through drops in the Orokin Void.
Reaper Prime, along with  Frost Prime,  Latron Prime,  Ember Prime,  Sicarus Prime, and  Glaive Prime, were unvaulted from December 6, 2016 to January 3, 2017 as part of the Fire and Ice Prime Vault.
The same line-up was unvaulted from January 29, 2019 to March 26, 2019.
The same line-up was unvaulted from September 29, 2020 to December 15, 2020.

Trivia
Reaper Prime was the first primed melee weapon obtainable from the Void, as well as being the first primed melee weapon created without an unprimed counterpart.
Along with  Latron Prime, this was the first craftable prime weapon.
Originally, the Reaper Prime's codex description described the blade as "forged from tempered Rubidium", an alkali metal that's too soft and too light to be used for melee weapons. It has since been changed to mention  Rubedo.
